//: Coverage gate for the console's non-screen src (lib, components, shell, root). The validators under test/ (npm run validate) are the test surface; c8 instruments them. The workerd vitest-pool suite is a runtime smoke test, not the coverage source. Thresholds enforce a floor of 90 per cent on every dimension.
//screens: src/screens/** is excluded here; it has its own config and floors at .c8rc.screens.json (npm run coverage:screens). Keeping the two apart is deliberate: a merged aggregate would lower the bar for the region that already holds 90. Two regions, two honest floors.
//functions-branches: 85 rather than 90: this public tree's test surface is the subset of the private validator suite that is customer-relevant (build, test, release), and the smaller surface measures 88.27/86.64 on functions/branches against the 95.12 on lines/statements. The floor is set just under the measured figures as a ratchet against regression, not left at the private repo's own 90.
